title: IST.PT.------POL.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 474 (MP(I)-48). IST-PT (isolated particulars) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names POL-DY (political dynamics); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: POL-DYM (political dynamics) and INFO-TRNS (information transference), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INFO-TRNS: MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) and MOT-DY. From MOT-DY: PART (participation). From PART: PROG-SIGN (progressional significance). From PROG-SIGN: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: AFI (affinity insight).
